tools.name: csv_to_json
tools.description: Convert CSV data to a JSON array of objects. First row is used as headers. Handles quoted fields and escaped commas. Use when the user has CSV data and wants JSON.

tools.name: json_to_csv
tools.description: Convert a JSON array of objects to CSV format. Object keys become the header row. Use when the user has JSON data and wants CSV.

json.description: A JSON string containing an array of objects, e.g. '[{"name":"Alice","age":30}]'

tools.name: yaml_to_json
tools.description: Convert YAML to JSON. Supports basic YAML: key-value pairs, nested objects, lists, and multi-line strings. Use when converting YAML config or data to JSON.

tools.name: json_to_yaml
tools.description: Convert a JSON object or array to YAML format. Produces clean, indented YAML output. Use when generating config files or human-readable data.

json.description: A JSON string to convert to YAML

tools.name: xml_to_json
tools.description: Convert basic XML to a JSON structure. Attributes become '@attr' keys, text content becomes '#text', and child elements become nested objects. Use for converting simple XML data to JSON.

xml.description: The XML text to convert to JSON

tools.name: markdown_to_html
tools.description: Convert Markdown text to HTML. Supports headings, bold, italic, links, images, code blocks (fenced and inline), lists, and horizontal rules. Use for rendering Markdown to display in HTML pages.

markdown.description: The Markdown text to convert to HTML
